A feedback survey: overall rating 1-5 (integer), what went well (multi-line), would you recommend (toggle), and a submit button.
Show weekly sales Monday to Friday as a bar chart with two series: online [120, 150, 90, 170, 200] and store [80, 60, 110, 95, 130].
Show the release plan as steps with their status: run tests (done), build (in progress), deploy to staging (blocked, waiting for approval), announce (not started).
A settings page with two sections: General (site name, language) and Notifications (email toggle, frequency daily or weekly). Show one section at a time.
Ask me to rate the support I received from 1 to 5 stars and leave an optional comment.
Show the shell command to rebuild the docker image, `docker build -t app:latest .`, so I can copy it.
Show the disk usage breakdown as proportions of the whole: system 40 GB, apps 120 GB, media 85 GB, free 255 GB.

Make a settings page for a blog with an Appearance part (theme, font size) and a Privacy part (analytics toggle, cookie banner toggle).
How was your experience with our support team? We would like a score and optional comments.
Tell me how to rebuild the docker image: the command is docker build -t app:latest .
